content:
as a new player (2 weeks) that was around before the shop updated, this actually really annoys me. the addition of the gnosis at the same rate was an actual nice qol change, but this price hike is ridiculous (especially so for the advanced skill materials).

there's a benefit to having 1 whole item in the shop vs buying the shards (it makes the items more tangible since it's vastly easier to keep track of how many rose scrips you have than to keep track of how many aetheric shards & mimetic crystals you have in addition to the rose scrip cost of them), but this is honestly the wrong direction.

you do get more aetheric stones faster (3 in 1 month with the new shop vs 1 in 2 months with the old shop) so the price increase can at least be justified a little (except it punishes players that didn't mind waiting), but with advanced skill materials it's a 51.5% increase in price for all units just to have 1 more every single month (3 in 1 month with new shop vs 2 in 1 month with old shop).

this honestly just seems like a way to force people to buy the battle pass. this along with reading other posts in the forum about recent and past changes doesn't paint a good impression for me to becoming a long time player.

**the solution to the problem is simple in my opinion: just offer both options** (the cheaper aetheric shards and mimetic crystals along with the more expensive advanced skill materials and aetheric stones). that way you're still paying a premium for getting more faster, but the option to slowly accumulate them at a cheaper price exists and those players aren't punished.
